name: CSM RC33 public business/legal corpus benchmark
description: Benchmark built without client documents, court judgments or blank forms. It uses structures observed in public contract registers, public administrative-decision portals, public procurement contract templates and SUDOP-like public-aid search pages, with synthetic or public-source-derived identifiers.

brpo_contract_register.description: Public contract-register entries with Kontrahent/nazwa rows, natural persons, companies, law offices, trade names and contract metadata.

uodo_decision_portal.description: Public portal showing administrative decisions of the President of UODO with decision-number patterns such as DKN.5112.33.2022.

uokik_decision_database.description: Public UOKiK decision database; used for administrative-decision number structure and entrepreneur/company-party contexts.

gov_procurement_contracts.description: Public procurement/contract templates, not blank identification forms; used for contract numbers, parties, payment clauses and contractor rows.

parp_contract_template.description: Public contract template used for zleceniodawca/zleceniobiorca, B2B parties, contract numbers and settlement identifiers.

sudop_public_aid_search.description: SUDOP search/result structures for beneficiary name, entrepreneur name, NIP and public-aid reference numbers.
